input.goal: Create index.html: a self-contained animated sorting-algorithm visualizer (Bubble, Insertion, Quick sort) on 40 random bars, dark theme, no external dependencies, zero JS errors.
input.request: Crea da zero index.html: visualizzatore animato di algoritmi di ordinamento su un array di 40 valori casuali mostrati come barre verticali. Controlli: Play/Pause (parte in pausa mostrando Play), Step (un confronto alla volta), Reset (nuovo array casuale, di nuovo in pausa), menu per scegliere tra Bubble sort, Insertion sort e Quick sort, slider velocità. Evidenzia con colori diversi le barre confrontate e quelle già ordinate e mostra il numero di confronti e di scambi. Tema scuro, zero dipendenze esterne e zero errori JavaScript.
constraints: Single file index.html with inline <style> and <script>; no external URLs, fonts, CDNs or images.
Page lang="it", title 'Visualizzatore di algoritmi di ordinamento'; UI labels in Italian.
Dark theme: body background #0f1117, text #e6e6e6, font system-ui, sans-serif; panels background #1a1d27 with 8px border-radius.

Array of exactly 40 random integers in range 5..100 inclusive, rendered as 40 vertical bars (div.bar) inside #bars, a flex container 100% width (max 960px, centered) and 360px tall, bars aligned to the bottom, gap 2px, bar height = value% of the container height.
Bar colors: default #4a90e2; bars currently being compared #f5a623; bars just swapped/moved #e94e77; bars in final sorted position #2ecc71.
Controls row above the bars: button#play, button#step, button#reset, select#algo, input#speed type=range.
button#play text is 'Play' while paused and 'Pause' while playing; the page starts paused showing 'Play'.
select#algo options values 'bubble','insertion','quick' with labels 'Bubble sort','Insertion sort','Quick sort'; default 'bubble'. Changing algorithm pauses and resets with a new random array.

input#speed min=1 max=100 value=50; delay between steps in ms = round(1000 - speed*9.9) clamped to min 10 (so 50 -> ~505ms, 100 -> 10ms). Changing speed while playing takes effect at the next step without restarting.

Implement each algorithm as a generator (function*) that yields once per comparison, so one Step = exactly one comparison (comparisons counter increases by exactly 1 per Step until sorted). Swaps/moves are applied within the step that follows their comparison.
Quick sort: Lomuto partition with last element as pivot; pivot index marked sorted after partition; subarrays of length 1 marked sorted.
Insertion sort counts each element shift as one swap.
Bubble sort: after each pass the last unsorted element is marked sorted; stops early if a pass makes no swaps (then all marked sorted).

When sorting completes: all 40 bars green #2ecc71, playback stops, button#play shows 'Play' and is disabled, button#step disabled; status text #status shows 'Ordinato!'. Otherwise #status shows 'In pausa' or 'In esecuzione'.
Counters: span#comparisons and span#swaps showing integers, labeled 'Confronti:' and 'Scambi:'. Reset sets both to 0.
button#reset: new random array of 40 values, counters 0, paused, play shows 'Play', buttons re-enabled, no highlighted bars.
Clicking Step while playing pauses first then does one step.
Legend below the bars showing the 4 colors with labels 'Normale','Confronto','Scambio','Ordinato'.

Expose window.app = { values (current array, live reference or getter), comparisons (number), swaps (number), playing (boolean), algorithm (string), done (boolean), sortedCount (number of bars marked sorted), step(), reset(), play(), pause() } kept in sync with UI.
No console errors or uncaught exceptions at any time, including Step after completion (no-op) and rapid Reset during play.

content.text:
I've created `index.html`, and it works now. Tandem wrote the first version, but its check ended in an unclear failure and the follow-up retry made no repairs, so I fixed the rest myself.

**What I fixed:**
- **Quick sort** stopped after a single comparison and didn't sort the array.
- **Insertion sort** said it was finished but left the array unsorted.
- **Highlighting:** the colors for compared and swapped bars never showed up because each redraw erased them.

I rewrote the three algorithms so each Step is exactly one comparison.

**What I checked**, in a headless browser:
- **Startup:** 40 bars, paused, with the button showing "Play".
- **Step:** each click adds exactly one comparison.
- **Play/Pause:** the button switches between Play and Pause and the animation runs.
- **Reset:** gives a new random array, sets the counters to 0 and pauses again.
- **All three algorithms:** each one sorts fully, then all bars turn green and the status shows "Ordinato!".
- **Page:** dark background, no external resources, and no JavaScript errors.

A screenshot showed the compared bars in orange and the counters updating. I didn't separately check the speed slider's timing or the red color for swaps.

One small thing: in Step mode, after the last comparison you need one more click to show "Ordinato!"; that click doesn't add a comparison. During playback this happens on its own.
